Run uncommitted changes through CI before you commit

## Usage

`circleci preflight <command> [flags]`

## Available Commands

| Command   | Description                                                   |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cleanup` | Delete preflight branches left on the remote                  |
| `run`     | Push the working tree to a temporary branch and watch its run |

## Flags

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Details

Run your working tree through CircleCI without committing it.

A preflight snapshots the working tree — staged, unstaged and untracked
changes, minus ignored files — into one commit on a throwaway branch
under `cci/preflight/`, diffed against the default branch, pushes it,
and lets the project's push trigger start a run. Your HEAD, index and
working tree are never touched.
Jobs can detect a preflight from the branch name, e.g.
`[[ $CIRCLE_BRANCH == cci/preflight/* ]]`.
